# Stablecoin Swap

> Stablecoin Swap is a non-custodial web interface for swapping between dollar stablecoins such as USDT, USDC and DAI on Ethereum. It routes through stable-to-stable pools where slippage is usually low. Users connect their own wallet and sign every transaction.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Supported idea: swapping between dollar stablecoins such as USDT, USDC and DAI on Ethereum.
- Stable-to-stable pools keep slippage low because their curves are flat near equal prices.
- USDT and USDC are company-issued; DAI is created by a protocol against collateral.
- Stablecoins can depeg, so the quote should be checked rather than assumed to be 1:1.
- Non-custodial: the user signs every swap and the interface never holds funds or keys.

## Pages

- Stablecoin Swap & learn: https://stablecoin-swap.github.io/
- Legal: https://stablecoin-swap.github.io/legal.html
